_activity: Build the thesis: who self-government was for
_licence: ORIGINAL, built on the shipped 11.1 casefiles. Quotes are the casefile's own text.
intro: Build the sentence. Drag the correct piece into each blank.

tiles.text: the Fundamental Orders let Connecticut settlers elect their own leaders
colonial self-government did not include everyone
married women lost their legal identity under coverture
the colonies were near the ocean

correct_sentence: Although the Fundamental Orders let Connecticut settlers elect their own leaders, colonial self-government did not include everyone because married women lost their legal identity under coverture.
rationale: The Documents 17 and 18 pair from 11.1 Casefile B: self-government was real (Document 17), and it left out married women (Document 18).
hints: The first blank is the best point for the other side.
The reason should prove somebody was left out.
